TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_contact
TABLE.COMMENT: One WhatsApp number and its consent

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: WhatsApp: country code and number, digits only; Telegram: tg: and the chat

FIELD.NAME: channel
FIELD.COMMENT: whatsapp or telegram

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Profile name WhatsApp sent, if any

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: Language for the messages; empty means the site language

FIELD.NAME: silent
FIELD.COMMENT: Telegram: notices that do not hurry arrive without sound

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, active or optedout

FIELD.NAME: consenttime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the last opt-in happened

FIELD.NAME: consentsource
FIELD.COMMENT: How the last opt-in happened: keyword, page or admin

FIELD.NAME: optouttime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the last opt-out happened

FIELD.NAME: lastinbound
FIELD.COMMENT: Last message from this number: opens the 24-hour window

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_link
TABLE.COMMENT: Whom a contact stands for: a Moodle user or an item of another plugin, with the code that claims it

FIELD.NAME: contactid
FIELD.COMMENT: Empty until somebody writes the code

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle user, if the link is for one

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Plugin that asked for the link

FIELD.NAME: area
FIELD.COMMENT: What kind of item of that plugin, such as the kitchen beside the diners; empty for its usual items

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: Item of that plugin, such as a family

FIELD.NAME: code
FIELD.COMMENT: Code the family writes after the opt-in keyword

FIELD.NAME: bynumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether it stands because the family records say the number is that adult's, not because of a code

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_consent
TABLE.COMMENT: Every opt-in and opt-out, kept as proof

FIELD.NAME: action
FIELD.COMMENT: optin or optout

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: keyword, page or admin

FIELD.NAME: detail
FIELD.COMMENT: Id of the WhatsApp message or who did it

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_tpl
TABLE.COMMENT: The WhatsApp template of each notice in each language, and what Meta says of it

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: Plugin that declares the notice

FIELD.NAME: notice
FIELD.COMMENT: Notice, as the plugin names it

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle language of the text

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the template in Meta

FIELD.NAME: metaid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id Meta gave to the template

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, approved, rejected, paused or disabled, as Meta says

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: utility or marketing, as Meta says

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why Meta rejected it, if it did

FIELD.NAME: body
FIELD.COMMENT: The text sent to Meta

FIELD.NAME: nextname
FIELD.COMMENT: The template that will replace this one, under a new name, or the old one to delete from Meta

FIELD.NAME: nextmetaid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id Meta gave to that template

FIELD.NAME: nextstatus
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, rejected… as Meta says, or retired for the old one to delete

FIELD.NAME: nextcategory
FIELD.COMMENT: Its category, as Meta says

FIELD.NAME: nextreason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why Meta rejected it, if it did

FIELD.NAME: nextbody
FIELD.COMMENT: Its text

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_queue
TABLE.COMMENT: Every notice for every number: waiting, sent, delivered or not

FIELD.NAME: params
FIELD.COMMENT: Values of the template, JSON

FIELD.NAME: rich
FIELD.COMMENT: Parts of its card on Telegram, if it has one, JSON

FIELD.NAME: ref
FIELD.COMMENT: For a question, what the plugin that asked needs to know it again

FIELD.NAME: itemid
FIELD.COMMENT: For a question, the item of the plugin it went to

FIELD.NAME: area
FIELD.COMMENT: For a question, the kind of that item

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: The language its plugin asked for, if the site has it; the person's own choice goes first

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the button of the notice goes, on this site

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: The end of the link of the button

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: queued, sent, delivered, read, failed or expired

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: template, paid; text, free inside the 24 hours

FIELD.NAME: wamid
FIELD.COMMENT: Id Meta gave to the message

FIELD.NAME: errorcode
FIELD.COMMENT: Error code of Meta, to tell the reason in plain words

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Tries after errors that pass

FIELD.NAME: timeretry
FIELD.COMMENT: Not before this time, after an error that passes

FIELD.NAME: timesent
FIELD.COMMENT: When it went out, or when it failed

FIELD.NAME: timeclosed
FIELD.COMMENT: When a question stopped taking answers: answered elsewhere, or past its time

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_answer
TABLE.COMMENT: Every answer to a question, as it came: who, which button, when and the ids of the messages

FIELD.NAME: queueid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question, in the queue

FIELD.NAME: choice
FIELD.COMMENT: The key of the answer

FIELD.NAME: messageid
FIELD.COMMENT: The id of the answer: wamid, or tgq. and the id of the press

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: The id of the message it answers

FIELD.NAME: timeanswered
FIELD.COMMENT: Meta's time; on Telegram, the arrival

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_post
TABLE.COMMENT: What goes to the channel of Telegram of the site: waiting for whoever reviews it, for its time, or already there

FIELD.NAME: component
FIELD.COMMENT: The plugin that posts it

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: What it is, as the plugin declares it

FIELD.NAME: sourcekey
FIELD.COMMENT: What the plugin knows it by, to change or take it back; empty if nothing

FIELD.NAME: content
FIELD.COMMENT: Its title, image, lines, text, link and label, JSON

FIELD.NAME: urgent
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether it goes at any hour

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: review, ready, published, skipped, cancelled, expired, remove, removed or failed

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: For the buttons of the review and the link of the post

FIELD.NAME: timeplanned
FIELD.COMMENT: Not before this time

FIELD.NAME: timeexpires
FIELD.COMMENT: Not after this time, if it has one

FIELD.NAME: reviews
FIELD.COMMENT: The messages that asked each reviewer, JSON

FIELD.NAME: timereview
FIELD.COMMENT: When it went to whoever reviews

FIELD.NAME: decidedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Who said to post it or to skip it

FIELD.NAME: messageid
FIELD.COMMENT: The id of the message in the channel

FIELD.NAME: clicks
FIELD.COMMENT: Visits through its link

FIELD.NAME: reactions
FIELD.COMMENT: Its reactions in the channel, anonymous, as Telegram counts them: emoji and how many, as JSON

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_chstat
TABLE.COMMENT: How many people the channel of Telegram had each day

FIELD.NAME: timeday
FIELD.COMMENT: The start of the day, in the time zone of the site

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_conv
TABLE.COMMENT: The index of the conversations of Chatwoot: department, who has it, state, contact, wait and last message

FIELD.NAME: cwid
FIELD.COMMENT: The number of the conversation in the account of Chatwoot

FIELD.NAME: teamid
FIELD.COMMENT: The department, or 0

FIELD.NAME: assigneeid
FIELD.COMMENT: The person of Chatwoot who has it, or 0

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: open, pending, snoozed or resolved

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: Only digits, with the country code

FIELD.NAME: kind
FIELD.COMMENT: What the team marked the contact as, comma separated, or empty

FIELD.NAME: kindface
FIELD.COMMENT: The mark whose face it has in the lists

FIELD.NAME: kindnote
FIELD.COMMENT: The lines of its marks, for the lists

FIELD.NAME: kindnotes
FIELD.COMMENT: Each line of its marks, as JSON, for its file

FIELD.NAME: waitsince
FIELD.COMMENT: The first message of the contact after the last answer of a person, or 0

FIELD.NAME: lastincoming
FIELD.COMMENT: The last message of the contact: one can write freely for a day after it

FIELD.NAME: preview
FIELD.COMMENT: The last message, as text

FIELD.NAME: lastmsgid
FIELD.COMMENT: The last message it looked at, to tell of the new ones

FIELD.NAME: passedby
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who passed it last, or 0

FIELD.NAME: passedto
FIELD.COMMENT: The person of Chatwoot it was passed to, or 0

FIELD.NAME: passedteam
FIELD.COMMENT: The department it was passed to, or 0

FIELD.NAME: cwupdated
FIELD.COMMENT: When Chatwoot last changed it, as it says it

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When its row changed: what the page asks for

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_convseen
TABLE.COMMENT: When each person last read each conversation

FIELD.NAME: convid
FIELD.COMMENT: The number of the conversation in Chatwoot

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_convmsg
TABLE.COMMENT: Who wrote each message sent from Moodle

FIELD.NAME: cwmsgid
FIELD.COMMENT: The message in Chatwoot

FIELD.NAME: convid
FIELD.COMMENT: The number of its conversation in Chatwoot

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_hist
TABLE.COMMENT: The chats and contacts of a number that came from the app of WhatsApp Business, as Meta sent them once

FIELD.NAME: field
FIELD.COMMENT: history or smb_app_state_sync

FIELD.NAME: payload
FIELD.COMMENT: The value of the change, as JSON

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_convrem
TABLE.COMMENT: The day a person asked to be reminded of a conversation, with what for

FIELD.NAME: cwid
FIELD.COMMENT: The number of the conversation in Chatwoot

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who asked for it

FIELD.NAME: remindat
FIELD.COMMENT: When: the opening of the day chosen

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: What for, in a line

FIELD.NAME: timedone
FIELD.COMMENT: When it came back; 0 while it waits

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_board
TABLE.COMMENT: The notices of the board of the team: for some departments or the whole team, each person marks them seen

FIELD.NAME: authorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who put it

FIELD.NAME: audience
FIELD.COMMENT: all, or the departments, comma separated

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Also when someone marks it seen

FIELD.NAME: timeedited
FIELD.COMMENT: When its text changed

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_boardto
TABLE.COMMENT: Who each notice of the board is for, and when each one saw it

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniamarandu_optout
TABLE.COMMENT: What a number or a chat said no to, short of everything: the notices of one plugin, such as admissions

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: The plugin whose notices they do not want

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Where it was asked

TABLE.COMMENT: A send to many at once asked by a plugin, with what it costs and its approval

FIELD.COMMENT: The plugin that asked for it

FIELD.NAME: area
FIELD.COMMENT: The kind of item

FIELD.NAME: notice
FIELD.COMMENT: The notice it sends

FIELD.NAME: label
FIELD.COMMENT: What it is, for whoever approves it

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who asked for it

FIELD.NAME: whatsapp
FIELD.COMMENT: Messages that cost

FIELD.NAME: skipped
FIELD.COMMENT: Items nobody of which can get it

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending, queued, rejected or cancelled

FIELD.COMMENT: Why it was rejected

FIELD.NAME: onlyby
